services.desc: Looking for the ideal vacation rental in Southern Delaware? From Rehoboth Beach, Lewes, Dewey Beach, and Bethany Beach to Broadkill Beach and Indian River Bay, explore a wide variety of options that cater to your unique needs. Whether you’re seeking a charming beach cottage, a spacious family-friendly home, or a luxurious bayside retreat, you’ll find rentals perfect for short weekend getaways, week-long vacations, or full-season stays. Available year-round, these rentals provide the flexibility to enjoy Southern Delaware’s stunning beaches, charming towns, and outdoor adventures in any season-spring, summer, fall, or winter. services.name: Farm Tours
services.desc: While most visitors believe that Sussex County’s #1 industry is sunshine and surf, it's actually agriculture that's our biggest economic driver. That's great news for visitors (and locals!) because it means Southern Delaware's Culinary Coast restaurants serve delicious dishes created with the freshest possible ingredients directly from our local farms. It also means you can enjoy adventures like visiting farms and u-picks, taking farm tours, meeting our farmers, and enjoying fantastic farmers markets which you'll find nearly every day in season.
